record.reason: DiffuGR reframes generative document retrieval as discrete diffusion over DocIDs, generating tokens in parallel with a controllable number of denoising steps that explicitly trades retrieval quality against latency at inference; the decoding mechanism is inference-relevant, but the contribution is a retrieval application, not LLM serving.
record.title: DiffuGR: Generative Document Retrieval with Diffusion Language Models
